pages.title: The fen's own
text: Among the reeds and mud channels live a frog, a heron and a puffer that floats in the air, and at night a cobra wakes in the grass.

Every gentle beast here can be brushed for its reagent once a minute, and is tempted and bred with its own food, named under **Hunting and herding** below. It can be bonded like any gentle animal (see [familiars](familiars)), though none of them has a familiar gift of its own.

pages.title: Marsh Hopper
text: A small fen frog, quick to jump, in groups of two to four. **12 health**, no armour.
It drops **1 to 3 Marsh Feet**, more with Looting.
Hunted, it also drops up to 1 Raw Game, up to 1 Rabbit Hide and up to 1 Slimeball. Breed with **Fen Rice**.

pages.title: Fen Strider
text: A tall heron, wading on stilt legs, in herds of two to four. **22 health** and **1 armour**.
Hunted, it also drops 1 to 3 Raw Game, up to 2 March Leather and up to 1 Bone. Breed with **Fen Rice**.

pages.title: Bog Floater
text: A green balloon puffer, blown up round and prickly, that drifts over the fen in ones to threes. **12 health**, no armour. A few drift along with the [Colossus Warden](colossus_warden).
Hunted, it also drops up to 1 Slimeball and up to 1 String. Breed with **Fen Rice**.

pages.title: Reed Coil
text: A marsh cobra, coiled with its hood spread, that rises on the fen's open ground at night, one to three at a time. It is very slow, but it has **30 health** and **6 armour**, hits for **5** and shoves you back with every blow.
It drops **1 to 2 Reed Whorls**, a Shove reagent.
Hunted, it also drops up to 1 March Leather and up to 1 Bone.

pages.title: Hunting and herding
text: Besides its reagent, each one drops more when hunted, and more again with Looting. Meat drops roasted if the animal died burning. To breed wild ones, **sneak** while you feed two adults their food; fed normally, a wild one warms to you instead.
